note: Re-judged 2026-10-26 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change, after ece74e2827 (spec-bgp-rs-replacement-on-withdrawal). RFC 2545 Section 3: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if and only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." The only change is to the tagged carrier test/plugin/rfc2545-joint-subnet.ci: each of the eight peers in the four cases (same-link, split-link, entity-off-link, recipient-off-link) gains attach process rs { receive [ update-received ]; send [ update ]; }, naming the internal rs (bgp-rs) process the config already declares. After 2de6f30f3b the rs fast path forwards only between peers granting the relay those permissions, so without the lines every case would see no forwarded UPDATE at all; the grants restore the route under test and change no input byte, no expect, no reject. The positive still requires the exact next hop of length 0x20 (global 2001:db8:a::9 plus fe80::9) at P on the real common link; the negatives still require the exact 16-octet global-only field and reject fe80::9 anywhere. Producers link_scope.go classify and linkLocalNextHop are byte-identical. The carrier is needs-linux (net-admin) and ece74e2827 records it has not yet run on the new config; that is a run owed, not a change in what it proves. Tested: "only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." Gap: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if". Producer: internal/component/bgp/reactor/link_scope.go::linkLocalNextHop, with classify: a third-party global on a common subnet still gets no matching link-local, so the if-half stays unimplemented. Verdict unchanged: partial. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
